description: This file contains utility functions for product configuration, filtering, and retrieval in an ERP system, specifically for the product configurator in the ERPNext platform.

methods.name: get_field_filter_data
methods.description: Retrieves filter data for product fields based on product settings and item meta.

methods.name: get_attribute_filter_data
methods.description: Builds a list of item attributes and marks selected values based on request URL.

methods.name: get_products_for_website
methods.description: Fetches products based on field and attribute filters, or search query.

methods.name: get_products_html_for_website
methods.description: Generates HTML for product listings based on filters.

methods.name: set_item_group_filters
methods.description: Sets item group filters to include child groups.

methods.name: get_item_codes_by_attributes
methods.description: Retrieves item codes matching specified attribute filters.

methods.name: get_attributes_and_values
methods.description: Builds a list of item attributes and their valid values.

methods.name: get_next_attribute_and_values
methods.description: Finds next attribute options and matching items based on selected attributes.

methods.name: get_items_with_selected_attributes
methods.description: Returns items matching selected attribute values.

methods.name: get_items_by_fields
methods.description: Retrieves items filtered by specified field values.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Fetches items with optional filters and search, with pagination.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions from filter list.

methods.name: get_item_attributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes for a given item code.

methods.name: get_html_for_items
methods.description: Generates HTML snippets for a list of items.
